keywords: ERC-8441 混合后量子隐身地址
summary: ACDC #190 上 Alex Stokes 卸任共识层会议主持，Ben Edgington 接任、Will Corcoran 任副手；Hegotá 共识层定范围完成，EIP-8015 列为 SFI，EIP-8205 被拒并改由后量子存款合约解决。ERC-8441 混合后量子隐身地址合并，leanXMSS 在 Lean4 中有了第一个可用版本，计划用于 EIP-8450。

items.title: ERC-8441：混合后量子隐身地址方案
items.note: 合并（namnc）。定义 ERC-5564 的 `schemeId` 3，支付秘密结合 ML-KEM-768 封装和 secp256k1 ECDH 秘密，即使对手以后拥有量子计算机，也无法从公告日志判断谁被付款；花费仍用 secp256k1，已部署的 ERC-5564 公告合约和 ERC-6538 注册表不变。
items.title_en: ERC-8441: hybrid post-quantum stealth address scheme
items.note_en: Was merged (namnc). It defines ERC-5564 `schemeId` 3, whose payment secret combines an ML-KEM-768 encapsulation with a secp256k1 ECDH secret, so an adversary who later gains a quantum computer still cannot tell from the announcement log who was paid. Spending stays on secp256k1, and the deployed ERC-5564 announcer and ERC-6538 registry are used unchanged.

items.title: ACDC #190
items.note: （据 Ethereal news #45 汇总）：Alex Stokes 卸任 ACDC 主持，Ben Edgington 接任，Will Corcoran 任副手。Hegotá 共识层定范围完成：EIP-8015（移除 deposit 和 eth1data 字段）SFI；EIP-8334、EIP-8383、EIP-8148、EIP-8411 CFI；EIP-8205（提款凭证预注册）DFI，改由后量子存款合约解决。
items.note_en: (as summarized by Ethereal news #45): Alex Stokes is stepping down as ACDC facilitator, Ben Edgington takes over as lead and Will Corcoran as deputy. Hegotá consensus layer scoping is finished: EIP-8015 (remove deposit and eth1data fields) is SFI; EIP-8334, EIP-8383, EIP-8148 and EIP-8411 are CFI; EIP-8205 (withdrawal credentials preregistration) is DFI, to be solved through a post-quantum deposit contract.

keywords_en: Alex Stokes steps down as facilitator
summary_en: At ACDC #190, Alex Stokes stepped down as consensus call facilitator, with Ben Edgington taking over as lead and Will Corcoran as deputy. Hegotá consensus layer scoping finished: EIP-8015 is SFI, and EIP-8205 was declined, to be solved through a post-quantum deposit contract instead. ERC-8441 hybrid post-quantum stealth addresses was merged, and leanXMSS has a first working version in Lean4, planned for EIP-8450.
